title: NotebookLM in Action: 7 Killer Use Cases for Agencies

facts.fact: The article is titled 'NotebookLM in Action: 7 Killer Use Cases for Agencies' and lists seven use cases for agencies.
facts.quote: NotebookLM in Action: 7 Killer Use Cases for Agencies

facts.fact: The page labels itself as a 3-minute read.
NotebookLM lets users upload their own sources and then works exclusively from that material, rather than from general internet data.
facts.quote: Instead of asking an AI to “figure it out” from the internet, NotebookLM lets you upload your own sources, and then works exclusively from that material.

facts.fact: The article states that most generative AI tools are trained on large volumes of publicly available data.
facts.quote: Most generative AI tools are trained on large volumes of publicly available data.

facts.fact: Mike Kaput, Chief Content Officer at SmarterX and the Marketing AI Institute, is scheduled to demonstrate NotebookLM in his session at the AI for Agencies Summit.
